overall_assessment: For UiS the core splits work in both extraction paths: learning outcomes keep all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, prerequisites are clean, and 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen/vurdering' reliably separates coursework_requirements from assessment. The defects sit in the FS-PDF text_split path. Loose substring heading matching lets course titles and reading-list entries that contain 'vurdering' or 'litteratur' open sections, so header metadata is filed as assessment or reading_list and reading lists are split into assessment. Unmapped FS headings (Åpen for, Emneevaluering, Overlapping) are appended to the preceding section in most courses, and Introduksjon and Praksis are unmapped and lost. Most pre-pass flags are false alarms: empty and boilerplate on teaching_methods, blob on the MGL3066/4066 reading lists, and leak->X on content lines that merely start with 'litteratur', 'Ferdigheter' or 'Arbeidskrav'. Separately, web-format course_plans lack the assessment body that html_headings captures (e.g. LENG115-2024, MGL2051-2025). That is a gap in the fulltext step, not a sections defect.

findings.evidence: læringsstrategier og læringsklima. Vurderingsform Vekting Varighet … knytte ulike arbeidskrav og aktivitetar. Bokkapittel Kapittel 3 Del eit dikt
findings.description: In FS-PDF plans the course title line is heading-shaped and contains a section keyword: 'Fagdidaktiske vurderinger i kroppsøvingsfaget' matches 'vurdering'; 'Introduksjon til engelskspråklig litteratur' and 'Litteratur, lesing, samtale - med vekt på mellomtrinnet' match 'litteratur'. The title therefore opens a section. The header metadata block (Emnekode, Vekting, Semester, Undervisningsspråk, Tilbys av) and the unheaded intro paragraph are filed as assessment, ahead of the real Eksamen/vurdering text (MGL3066, MGL4066), or as reading_list, ahead of the bibliography (MGL2120, LENG115). In LENG115-2017 the Introduksjon paragraph is then lost altogether. text_split drops blank lines inside a chunk, so the anonymizer's Fagpersoner regex, which removes text up to the next blank line, also removes the Introduksjon paragraph. Across the dataset, 60 UiS courses have 'Emnekode:' inside a section (19 assessment, 41 reading_list). The leak->reading_list and leak->course_content flags on these rows point at the right rows for the wrong reason.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: extract_sections_text() calls match_heading_to_section(word_start = TRUE). The substring patterns 'vurdering' and 'litteratur' match any line that .heading_shaped_line() accepts (at most 8 words, capitalised, no digits), and that includes the course title in the preamble.
findings.suggested_fix: For uis text_split, ignore heading candidates until the FS metadata block has passed. For example, add a cfg field (e.g. section_text_skip_until = '^(Emnekode|Tilbys av|Tilbydar|Undervisningsspråk):') and start matching only after the last such line. Alternatively, run text_split in exact-only mode for uis, as a whole-line match against the closed FS heading vocabulary. Also keep blank lines inside chunks (do not filter chunks[nzchar(chunks)] in flush()), so that paragraph-scoped anonymizer regexes do not run past the paragraph.

findings.evidence: Læreplan i samfunnsfag (SAF01-04) Utdanningsdirektoratet, https://www.udir.no/lk20/saf01-04View online Nettside … https://www.udir.no/lk20/saf01-04/kompetansemaal-og-vurdering/kv145View online Bok Internasjonale trender
findings.description: The reading-list entry title 'Kompetansemål og vurdering' sits on its own line after a blank line, looks like a heading, and matches the assessment pattern 'vurdering'. The reading_list row is cut after three entries (265 chars, ending at a bare 'Nettside'). The remaining ~32,700 chars of literature become the assessment row. These plans have no Eksamen/vurdering section, so the whole assessment row is bibliography. Across the dataset, 40 UiS assessment rows contain reading-list markers (isbn:, View online, Bokkapittel), mostly MGL plans from 2020-2021. The long, blob and leak flags on these rows are true positives.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The same loose substring matching in extract_sections_text(). Nothing protects reading_list once it is open, although it is the last content section in FS plans and is full of short, title-like lines.
findings.suggested_fix: In extract_sections_text(), once current_section == 'reading_list', allow a switch only on an exact whole-line heading match: in FS plans only fixed admin headings follow Litteratur. Alternatively, make the assessment patterns exact in text_split for uis ('eksamen/vurdering', 'eksamen / vurdering' as exact rows). Add a QA assertion that flags assessment rows containing 'isbn:' or 'View online'.

findings.evidence: Alle krav må være godkjent for at studenten kan stille til eksamen. Overlapping Emne Reduksjon (SP) … Emneevaluering Evalueringer utgjør en sentral del av kvalitetssystemet ved UiS
findings.description: In the text_split path, the FS trailer headings 'Overlapping', 'Åpen for'/'Åpent for'/'Ope for' and 'Emneevaluering' map to nothing, so they do not end the open section. Their content (overlap-credit tables, programme lists, course-evaluation boilerplate) is appended to the preceding section: teaching_methods after Arbeidsformer/Praksis (MGL3066, MGL2050, MGL2120); assessment (LENG115-2017, LFYMAS, LKJMAS, LMAMAS, LKJBAC); or coursework_requirements (EXPAED102, MGL1111, LMHIMAS). 'Arbeidsmengd' (workload) is appended to course_content the same way in MGL2120. Across the dataset, 2,040 of 2,728 UiS courses have one of these headings inside a section. The html_headings path (web pages, e.g. LENG115-2024, MGL2051-2025) drops them correctly.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: section_heading_patterns in R/section_heading_map.R has no row for these headings. extract_sections_text() switches section only on a mapped heading, whereas in html_headings an unmapped h2 closes the section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exact ('exact = TRUE') '.drop' rows to section_heading_patterns in R/section_heading_map.R: 'åpen for', 'åpent for', 'ope for', 'emneevaluering', 'overlapping', 'fagpersoner', 'arbeidsmengd'. The equality check runs before substring matching, so text_split will cut at these lines and .clean_sections() will discard their text.

findings.evidence: Praksis Studentene skal ha 2 eller 3 uker med veiledet praksis. Målsetningen er at studentene skal undervise i samfunnsfag
findings.description: 'Praksis' is not in the heading map. In web-format plans (html_headings) the Praksis h2 maps to NA and the placement description is discarded, so teaching_methods lacks the practicum that the codebook assigns to it. All 88 UiS web plans with a Praksis heading lose it. In FS-PDF plans the Praksis block survives only by accident: it is appended to the preceding section, which is usually teaching_methods but across the dataset is course_content in 24 rows and coursework_requirements in 26.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: There is no 'praksis' row in section_heading_patterns. Only 'faget i praksis' (uia, #201) is mapped to teaching_methods.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'praksis' -> teaching_methods with exact = TRUE in R/section_heading_map.R. This labels the block correctly in both html_headings and text_split.

findings.evidence: Introduksjon Emnet vil i størst grad knyttes opp mot de matematiske emnene tallære (naturlige tall, telling, regning, faktorisering
findings.description: The 'Introduksjon' heading (in 922 UiS plans) is unmapped. Newer FS-PDF plans (2020 onwards) place the same intro paragraph unheaded after the metadata block. Both forms are discarded, or misfiled when a title matched a heading (see the title finding). The intro often describes the subject matter, e.g. MGD1110 (tallære, sannsynlighetsregning og statistikk), MGL2051, MGL3066 ('Emnet legger vekt på å belyse sentrale fagdidaktiske problemstillinger') and the master-thesis intros. Under the codebook this is course_content ('Om emnet'-type text), and the map already sends 'innledning', 'kort om emnet' and 'om dette emnet' there. In LENG115 and EXPAED102, Introduksjon only repeats the start of Innhold, so nothing is lost for those courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: There is no 'introduksjon' row in section_heading_patterns. Text before the first mapped heading is dropped in both html_headings (initial_section NA) and text_split.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'introduksjon' -> course_content (exact = TRUE) in R/section_heading_map.R. For uis text_split, open course_content for the first paragraph after the FS metadata block, at the same skip point as the title fix. Drop that paragraph when it is a verbatim prefix of the Innhold text, to avoid duplication.

findings.evidence: Vekt Varighet Karakter Hjelpemidler Skriftlig eksamen 1/1 5 timer A-F A4-side med egne håndskrevne
findings.description: FS-PDF assessment rows start with the flattened exam table: a column-header line, then whitespace-padded columns with weight, duration, grade scale and permitted aids (e.g. 'Alle trykte eller håndskrevne hjelpemidler tillatt. Alle kalkulatorer tillatt.'). Form and weight are assessment design. Durations and aids are exam logistics that the codebook excludes, and the column padding is noise. The .clean_sections() docstring defers exam-table cleanup to Phase 2; this finding records that it is still pending.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The PDF table layout is preserved in extracted_text, and .section_noise has no uis entry.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a uis entry to .section_noise in R/extract_sections.R that removes the header line '(?m)^\s*(?:Vurderingsform\s+)?Vekt(?:ing)?\s+(?:Varighet|Lengd)\s+Karakter\s+Hjelpemidd?el(?:er)?\s*$', and collapse runs of 3 or more spaces in assessment rows. Optionally strip the trailing Hjelpemidler cell text.

findings.evidence: Muntlig presentasjon 1/4 A-F Emne LMAMAS_1, BOKMÅL, , versjon Vurderingsform: Oppgave og muntlig eksamen
findings.description: 2017-era FS PDFs repeat a running header ('Emne LMAMAS_1, BOKMÅL, , versjon') and a footer ('LFYMAS_1 - Masteroppgave fysikk - Lektor') at page breaks. Both survive inside assessment, learning_outcomes and reading_list rows, often in the middle of a sentence. The cruft is already in extracted_text and in course_plan, but the section step is the cheapest place to strip it from section text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: PDF page furniture is not removed before text_split, and .section_noise applies only to assessment and coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Before text_split for uis, remove lines matching '(?m)^\s*Emne [A-ZÆØÅ0-9_]+, (?:BOKMÅL|NYNORSK|ENGELSK).*versjon.*$', and remove lines equal to '<EMNEKODE> - <course title>' (code taken from course_id).
